synthesis: The Company Metrics 'LPR Recovery Leaderboard' collapsed card (RecoveryLeader::toStat()) headlines the leader's recovery-share count and a sparkline but never names the leading kit. The name is already computed and available -- leaderboardForSelectedRange() returns ['leader']['name'] and toStat() simply discards it. So this is a pure presentation gap, not a query gap. The complication: those name lines were REMOVED on purpose (commit 304d3c77e, 'Per Oscar, the Recovery Leaderboard card drops its leader/runner-up lines'), and a regression test pins that removal. The newer sibling card UniqueScansLeaderboard (DEV-2468) nonetheless ships a single-line ->description('Top Kit: ...'), so the grid is already inconsistent. Reversing Oscar's call is a product decision, not a code decision.

scope.summary: Add the leading kit's name as a single ->description('Top Kit: ...') line to the collapsed Stat of BOTH RecoveryLeader and StagingLiveHitLeader, mirroring UniqueScansLeaderboard, and update the RecoveryLeader tests that currently pin the no-names behaviour.

proposed_changes.change: In toStat(), capture leaderboardForSelectedRange() once and add ->description('Top Kit: '.($leader['name'] ?? 'N/A')); update the toStat() docblock, which currently documents the opposite ('no names ... dropped so this card is the same height as its siblings').
proposed_changes.reason: toStat() builds Stat::make(...)->chart(...)->color('info') with no ->description() while ['leader']['name'] is already computed and unused.

proposed_changes.change: Rework assertNoLeaderboardCardNames() and its 6 call sites to assert the LEADER name is present in the Stat description while the runner-up remains absent; rename/rewrite test_collapsed_card_headlines_the_leader_count_without_the_names and re-evaluate test_collapsed_card_never_carries_long_kit_names.
proposed_changes.reason: These tests deliberately encode the removal and will fail unmodified.

proposed_changes.change: In toStat(), replace the bare collect(...)->max('total') with sortByDesc('total')->first() so the count and the name come from the SAME row, then add ->description('Top Kit: '.($leader['name'] ?? 'N/A')). Keep the headline value numerically identical to today's max('total').
proposed_changes.reason: Identical no-name gap; scope widened by operator decision 2026-09-16. max('total') returns only a scalar, so a name cannot be derived from it without a second pass that could disagree with the displayed total.

proposed_changes.change: Add a test asserting the collapsed Stat description names the leading kit, and that the headline value is unchanged from the max('total') behaviour.
proposed_changes.reason: No existing test pins name presence/absence on this card, so the coverage is additive rather than an inversion.

questions.q: This reverses an explicit product decision: commit 304d3c77e says 'Per Oscar, the Recovery Leaderboard card drops its leader/runner-up lines -- the names still render on the expanded chart's getDescription(), which is where he wanted them', and test_collapsed_card_headlines_the_leader_count_without_the_names pins it. The newer sibling UniqueScansLeaderboard (DEV-2468) does show 'Top Kit: {name}' on its collapsed stat. Add the leader name back to this card (one line, sibling style), or close the ticket as working-as-designed and point QA at the expanded chart?
questions.answer: Add the leader name back. PROVENANCE RESOLVED: the decision is DEV-2324 comments 38495/38497/38501 (2026-08-20). Oscar asked only for HEIGHT ('same hight as the metrics at the top of the dashboard... minimize the amount of scrolling'); the names were the price Dalton offered in 38497, and Oscar accepted with 'we can lose those 2 names from the card. we can always display those on the expanded view.' That price no longer exists: resources/css/filament/app/theme.css:171 documents min-h-47 = 188px and states 'Every card is the same height whether or not it has a description'. Description space is reserved on every card, so one line costs 0px and Oscar's height constraint stays satisfied. He also released TWO names; this restores only the leader.
questions.source: human:Dalton 2026-09-16 (grounded in Jira DEV-2324 comments 38495/38497/38501 + theme.css:171)

questions.answer: 'Top Kit: {name}' — byte-identical to UniqueScansLeaderboard. Confirmed appropriate for StagingLiveHitLeader too: its leaderboard rows are ['id','name','total'] keyed on kits, same as the sibling.

questions.q: Does the underlying ClickHouse query already return the kit name, or must it be resolved separately?
questions.answer: Already returned. RecoveryLeaderQuery joins clarity.kits and selects k.name; summarizeMonth() normalizes it into ['leader']['name']. No query, join, or cross-connection lookup is needed -- this is presentation only.
